tools.name: describe_screen
tools.description: One-call digest of screens for writing requirements: location, link, designer notes next to the screen, Dev Mode annotations, all visible texts, prototype interactions, menus/modals connected by connector lines (with their texts), components with variants. Batch several screens.

file.description: Target file: key, Figma URL or (part of) the name. Required only when several files are connected.

fileUrl.description: Any Figma URL of this file; used for links when the plugin can't read the file key.

nearby.description: Distance in px to look for designer notes around the screen (default 400, 0 = off).

overwrite.description: Allow saveTo to replace an existing file.

relatedTexts.description: Max texts shown per related menu/modal (default 40).

saveTo.description: Write the text result to this file and return a preview.

screenshot.description: Also attach a screenshot of each screen.

screenshotMaxSize.description: Longest side of attached screenshots in px (default 1200).

skip.description: Layer names to ignore inside screens, e.g. the side menu repeated on every screen.

textMode.description: unique (default): each text once with a repeat count; all: every occurrence in layer order.

variantInteractions.description: Also list hover/press variant switches of design-system components.

tools.name: find_nodes
tools.description: Search layers by name, text content and/or type in the current page, the whole file, the selection or a subtree. Returns id, type, name, page, parent path, texts and absolute bounds.

file.description: Target file: key, Figma URL or (part of) the name. Required only when several files are connected.

fileUrl.description: Any Figma URL of this file; used for links when the plugin can't read the file key.

links.description: Add a Figma link to every result.

name.description: Substring of the layer name (case-insensitive), or a regex when regex=true.

nested.description: Also report matches nested inside other matches (default false).

overwrite.description: Allow saveTo to replace an existing file.

saveTo.description: Write the result to this file and return a preview.

scope.description: "page" (default, current page), "file" (all pages), "selection", or a node id to search inside.

text.description: Substring of the layer's text or of texts inside it.

textLimit.description: Max characters of texts per result (default 600).

types.description: Layer types, e.g. FRAME, INSTANCE, SECTION, TEXT, CONNECTOR, STICKY.

tools.name: get_annotations
tools.description: Dev Mode annotations in a subtree or the current page, with annotation categories.

file.description: Target file: key, Figma URL or (part of) the name. Required only when several files are connected.

nodeId.description: Root node. Omit for the current page.

tools.name: get_design_system
tools.description: Local styles (colors, text, effects), variables with values per mode, and components/component sets with their properties.

file.description: Target file: key, Figma URL or (part of) the name. Required only when several files are connected.

overwrite.description: Allow saveTo to replace an existing file.

saveTo.description: Write the result to this file and return a preview.

tools.name: get_links
tools.description: "Link to selection" URLs for nodes, ready for tasks and docs.

devMode.description: Open links in Dev Mode (default true).

file.description: Target file: key, Figma URL or (part of) the name. Required only when several files are connected.

fileUrl.description: Any Figma URL of this file; needed only when the plugin can't read the file key.

tools.name: get_metadata
tools.description: File name and key, all pages (id, name), current page and current selection.

file.description: Target file: key, Figma URL or (part of) the name. Required only when several files are connected.

tools.name: get_screenshot
tools.description: Render nodes as images the model can see. Keep maxSize modest: screenshots are the most expensive output.

file.description: Target file: key, Figma URL or (part of) the name. Required only when several files are connected.

nodeIds.description: Nodes to render (max 6). Omit to use the selection.

tools.name: get_text
tools.description: All texts in a subtree in layer order, each with its id and the names of the nearest meaningful parent layers. Good for copying menus, modals, tables, notes.

file.description: Target file: key, Figma URL or (part of) the name. Required only when several files are connected.

nodeId.description: Root node. Omit for the current page.

overwrite.description: Allow saveTo to replace an existing file.

saveTo.description: Write the result to this file and return a preview.

skip.description: Layer names to skip with their subtree.

withPath.description: Prefix each text with parent layer names (default true).

tools.name: get_tree
tools.description: Layer tree of a page, section, frame or the selection as compact indented text: type, id, name, size, texts, component props, prototype links (↳), annotations (✎), connectors. One line per layer.

depth.description: Levels to expand; -1 = unlimited. Default 12 for outline, 3 otherwise.

detail.description: outline (default): visible layers only, decorative shapes dropped, text-less subtrees collapsed, auto-named wrappers flattened. structure: every layer. styles: structure + layout, fills, fonts.

file.description: Target file: key, Figma URL or (part of) the name. Required only when several files are connected.

maxNodes.description: Stop after this many layers (default 4000, or 200000 with saveTo).

nodeId.description: Root node (page, section, frame…). Omit for the current page.

overwrite.description: Allow saveTo to replace an existing file.

positions.description: Add x,y for every layer (always shown for canvas-level layers).

resolveComponents.description: Show the main component of instances when it differs from the layer name.

saveTo.description: Write the full result to this file (relative to the working directory or in /tmp) and return a preview.

selection.description: Use the current Figma selection as roots.

skip.description: Layer names (or parts) / IDs to skip with their subtree, e.g. the repeated side menu.

variantInteractions.description: Also show hover/press variant switches (CHANGE_TO) of design-system components.

tools.name: list_files
tools.description: List Figma files where the plugin is running: name, key, current page, selection size.

tools.name: save_screenshots
tools.description: Render nodes and save them to files (nothing is returned inline). Use it for many screens, then read the files you need.

file.description: Target file: key, Figma URL or (part of) the name. Required only when several files are connected.

format.description: Default format when the extension doesn't say.

outputPath.description: Relative to the working directory, or in /tmp. Extension sets the format.

maxSize.description: Longest side in px for PNG/JPG (default 0 = no limit).

instructions:
figma-mcp-go reads Figma files through a local plugin (Figma Plugin API). No Figma REST API, no rate limits. All tools are read-only.

Before use, run the "Figma MCP Go" plugin in every Figma file you need (Plugins → Development). Several files can be connected at once; pass "file" (key, URL or name) when more than one is connected. Call list_files to see them.

Node IDs: "12:34", "12-34", instance sublayers "I12:34;56:78", or a Figma link with node-id — all accepted.

Workflow for analysing designs:
1. list_files → get_metadata (pages).
2. get_tree on a page with depth 2–3 to map sections and screens. Screens are usually 1440–1920 px frames or instances inside sections.
3. find_nodes name:"comment" (or text:"…") to locate designer notes; describe_screen also lists notes near each screen.
4. describe_screen for each screen (batch several nodeIds): texts, components with variants, prototype interactions, menus/modals linked by connectors, nearby notes, links.
5. get_text / get_tree on a single modal or menu when you need its exact structure.
6. get_screenshot only for visual questions (maxSize 1200–1600). Prefer save_screenshots + reading the file when you need many.
7. get_links for "link to selection" URLs to put into tasks.

Outputs are compact text. Large results: lower depth, narrow nodeId, or pass saveTo to write them to a file and read it in parts.
